build_or_update_graph_tool.intent: Build or incrementally update the code knowledge graph

run_postprocess_tool.intent: Run post-processing on existing graph (flows, communities, FTS)

get_minimal_context_tool.intent: Get ultra-compact context for any task (~100 tokens)

get_impact_radius_tool.intent: Blast radius of editing a symbol: how far a change to it reaches.

query_graph_tool.intent: Trace a known symbol's callers, callees, imports and what covers it — the structural answer a text search cannot give.

get_review_context_tool.intent: Generate a focused, token-efficient review context for code changes

semantic_search_nodes_tool.intent: Find code by describing what it does, when you do not know the file or symbol name. The entry point for 'where is X handled?'.

embed_graph_tool.intent: Compute vector embeddings for all graph nodes to enable semantic search

list_graph_stats_tool.intent: Get aggregate statistics about the code knowledge graph

get_docs_section_tool.intent: Get a specific section from the LLM-optimized documentation reference

find_large_functions_tool.intent: Find functions, classes, or files exceeding a line-count threshold

list_flows_tool.intent: List execution flows in the codebase, sorted by criticality

get_flow_tool.intent: Get detailed information about a single execution flow

get_affected_flows_tool.intent: Find execution flows affected by changed files

list_communities_tool.intent: List detected code communities in the codebase

get_community_tool.intent: Get detailed information about a single code community

get_architecture_overview_tool.intent: Orientation in an unfamiliar repository — its structure and major components — before reading any single file.

detect_changes_tool.intent: List what changed since the last graph update, as the starting point of a review rather than a git diff.

apply_refactor_tool.intent: Apply a previously previewed refactoring to source files

generate_wiki_tool.intent: Generate a markdown wiki from the community structure

get_wiki_page_tool.intent: Retrieve a specific wiki page by community name

get_hub_nodes_tool.intent: Find the most connected nodes in the codebase (architectural hotspots)

get_bridge_nodes_tool.intent: Find architectural chokepoints via betweenness centrality

get_knowledge_gaps_tool.intent: Identify structural weaknesses in the codebase graph

get_surprising_connections_tool.intent: Find unexpected architectural coupling via composite surprise scoring

get_suggested_questions_tool.intent: Auto-generate review questions from graph analysis

traverse_graph_tool.intent: BFS/DFS traversal from best-matching node with token budget

list_repos_tool.intent: List all registered repositories in the multi-repo registry

cross_repo_search_tool.intent: Search for code entities across all registered repositories

build_solution.intent: Build the currently opened solution or compile specific files

get_run_configurations.intent: Returns project run configurations or executable code locations

execute_run_configuration.intent: Run an existing run configuration or temporary one from code location

get_all_open_file_paths.intent: Returns active editor's and other open editors' file paths

get_file_text_by_path.intent: Retrieves the text content of a file using its path relative to project root

open_file_in_editor.intent: Opens the specified file in the JetBrains IDE editor

get_file_problems.intent: Analyze a file with Rider code analysis and return found errors

get_symbol_info.intent: Retrieves information about the symbol at the specified position

search_text.intent: Searches for a text substring within project files with match coordinates

search_regex.intent: Searches for regex matches within project files with coordinates

search_in_files_by_text.intent: Searches for a text substring within all files using IntelliJ search engine

search_in_files_by_regex.intent: Searches with a regex pattern within all files using IntelliJ search engine

search_file.intent: Searches for files by glob pattern within the project

find_files_by_glob.intent: Searches for all files whose relative paths match the specified glob pattern

find_files_by_name_keyword.intent: Searches for all files whose names contain the specified keyword

rename_refactoring.intent: Renames a symbol in the specified file with context-aware update of all references

move_type_to_namespace.intent: Move a type to another namespace, updating all references across the solution

reformat_file.intent: Reformat a file using the IDE code style settings

replace_text_in_file.intent: Replaces text in a file with flexible find and replace options

apply_patch.intent: Apply a patch using the Codex apply_patch format or unified git diff format

create_new_file.intent: Creates a new file at the specified path within the project directory

read_file.intent: Reads a file in the project directory or from any project dependency

list_directory_tree.intent: Provides a tree representation of the specified directory

get_solution_projects.intent: List all projects in the currently opened solution

get_project_dependencies.intent: Get dependencies for one project in the currently opened solution

execute_terminal_command.intent: Executes a specified shell command in the IDE's integrated terminal

execute_sql_query.intent: Executes a SQL query against the given database connection

list_database_connections.intent: Retrieves a list of configured database connections or data sources

list_database_schemas.intent: Retrieves a list of database schemas in the specified database connection

list_schema_objects.intent: Retrieves a list of database objects within the given schema

get_database_object_description.intent: Retrieves the structure of a database object

preview_table_data.intent: Previews data of a table, view, or materialized view

list_schema_object_kinds.intent: Retrieves supported schema object kinds for a connection

get_services.intent: Returns a list of all discovered services from OpenTelemetry data

get_service_map.intent: Generates an architectural map of services from distributed tracing data

get_spans.intent: Returns a list of spans from OpenTelemetry services

get_log_records.intent: Returns a list of log records from OpenTelemetry services

get_repositories.intent: Retrieves the list of VCS roots in the project

cancel_sql_query.intent: Cancels a running query using its unique ID

list_recent_sql_queries.intent: Retrieves a list of recent queries for a database connection

microsoft_docs_search.intent: Search official Microsoft/Azure documentation for relevant content

microsoft_docs_fetch.intent: Fetch and convert a Microsoft Learn documentation webpage to markdown

microsoft_code_sample_search.intent: Search for code snippets and examples in official Microsoft Learn documentation

browser_navigate.intent: Navigate to a URL in the browser

browser_snapshot.intent: Capture accessibility snapshot of the current page

browser_click.intent: Click on an element on the page

browser_tabs.intent: List, create, close, or select a browser tab

browser_take_screenshot.intent: Take a screenshot of the current page

browser_evaluate.intent: Evaluate JavaScript expression on page or element

browser_find.intent: Search the accessibility snapshot for text or regex

browser_select_option.intent: Select an option in a dropdown

browser_wait_for.intent: Wait for text to appear or disappear or time to pass

browser_network_requests.intent: Returns a numbered list of network requests

browser_network_request.intent: Returns full details of a single network request

browser_navigate_back.intent: Go back to the previous page

browser_drag.intent: Perform drag and drop between elements

browser_drop.intent: Drop files or data onto an element

conversations_list.intent: List active messaging conversations, optionally filtered by platform or name.

conversation_get.intent: Inspect one conversation's details using its session key.

messages_read.intent: Read recent message history from a selected conversation.

attachments_fetch.intent: Fetch non-text attachments from a specific message.

events_poll.intent: Poll for new conversation or approval events after a cursor.

events_wait.intent: Wait for the next conversation or approval event with a bounded timeout.

messages_send.intent: Send a text message through a connected platform target.

channels_list.intent: List available messaging targets across connected platforms.

permissions_list_open.intent: List pending approval requests observed by the bridge session.

permissions_respond.intent: Allow or deny a pending approval request.

memory_write.intent: Persist a durable, project-scoped fact with its source path — one fact per entry, never raw chatter.

memory_search.intent: Search project/shared memory (scope=all, project, or shared) with 2-3 formulations before web or code search.

memory_list.intent: List entries in a project's memory bank, optionally filtered.

memory_stats.intent: Report bank size and entry counts for a project.

memory_share.intent: Promote a durable, cross-project entry to the shared tier — curated and never swept.

memory_delete.intent: Delete a specific memory entry by id.

memory_delete_context.intent: Delete entries by context; requires full access mode.

memory_ingest_file.intent: Bulk-load a file's contents into project memory as entries.

memory_ingest_directory.intent: Bulk-load every supported file under a directory into project memory.

memory_embed_pending.intent: Embed pending entries; omit the limit argument to process all.

memory_workspace_begin.intent: Start an isolated workspace outbox for in-progress notes.

memory_workspace_status.intent: List what the active workspace outbox holds.

memory_workspace_consolidate.intent: Finish a workspace: keep durable facts, promote cross-project ones with memory_share, drop the rest.

memory_workspace_discard.intent: Discard an active workspace and its outbox without consolidating.

memory_sweep.intent: Remove old, low-rated project entries; shared entries are exempt.

memory_sync.intent: Exchange memory snapshots with cloud storage when configured.

memory_watch_add.intent: Register an absolute path to mirror into memory; the initial scan runs in the background.

memory_watch_status.intent: Report watch state (scanning/healthy/retrying/stopped) for a project; empty when none.

memory_watch_remove.intent: Stop mirroring a watched path; a no-op when the path is not watched.

get_graph_summary.intent: Orientation entry point: graph statistics, entity/relation counts, domain overview — before any specific query.

extract_entities.intent: Named entity extraction from arbitrary text — feed in a document, conversation excerpt, or design spec and get structured entities back.

extract_relations.intent: Extract triplet relations (subject-predicate-object) from text — builds the graph's edge structure from unstructured content.

add_entity.intent: Manually add a knowledge graph node with properties — for facts already known but not present in text to extract.

add_relationship.intent: Manually add an edge between two existing entities — link concepts connected through reasoning.

record_decision.intent: Persist an architectural decision as a provenance-tracked node with context, rationale, alternatives, and constraints.

query_decisions.intent: Search the decision history by keyword, date range, or domain — 'what did we decide about authentication?'

find_precedents.intent: Semantic precedent lookup — 'has a decision like this been made before?' Returns similar past decisions ranked by relevance.

get_causal_chain.intent: Full causal ancestry of a decision or entity — trace every 'because' back to root assumptions.

run_reasoning.intent: Forward-chaining IF/THEN rules over the graph — derive new facts, check consistency, or flag conflicts.

export_graph.intent: Export the current graph in RDF, JSON, or Parquet format for archival snapshots or audit trails.
